senses.def: an earthquake
senses.ex: The quake destroyed hundreds of homes in the region.
senses.exPt: O terremoto destruiu centenas de casas na região.

senses.def: an exam you have passed or a course you have finished
senses.ex: He left school without any qualifications.
senses.exPt: Ele saiu da escola sem nenhum diploma.

senses.def: the fact of winning a place in a competition
senses.ex: The team celebrated their qualification for the World Cup.
senses.exPt: O time comemorou a classificação para a Copa do Mundo.

senses.def: having passed the exams or training needed for a job
senses.ex: She's a qualified nurse with ten years' experience.
senses.exPt: Ela é uma enfermeira qualificada com dez anos de experiência.

senses.def: to win a place in the next part of a competition
senses.ex: Our team qualified for the final last night.
senses.exPt: Nosso time se classificou para a final ontem à noite.

senses.def: to have the right to have or do something
senses.ex: Students qualify for a discount on train tickets.
senses.exPt: Estudantes têm direito a desconto nas passagens de trem.

senses.def: to pass the exams needed for a profession
senses.ex: She qualified as a nurse two years ago.
senses.exPt: Ela se formou em enfermagem há dois anos.

senses.def: how good or bad something is
senses.ex: These shoes are expensive, but the quality is excellent.
senses.exPt: Estes sapatos são caros, mas a qualidade é excelente.

senses.def: to measure or express something as an amount or number
senses.ex: It's difficult to quantify the damage caused by the storm.
senses.exPt: É difícil quantificar os danos causados pela tempestade.

senses.def: an amount or number of something
senses.ex: They sell food in large quantities.
senses.exPt: Eles vendem comida em grandes quantidades.

senses.def: a period when a person or animal is kept apart to stop a disease spreading
senses.ex: The sick passengers were kept in quarantine for two weeks.
senses.exPt: Os passageiros doentes ficaram em quarentena por duas semanas.

senses.def: an angry argument between people
senses.ex: They had a quarrel about money last night.
senses.exPt: Eles tiveram uma briga por causa de dinheiro ontem à noite.

senses.def: to have an angry argument
senses.ex: My parents often quarrel about where to go on holiday.
senses.exPt: Meus pais vivem brigando sobre onde passar as férias.

senses.def: often arguing with other people
senses.ex: My neighbour is a quarrelsome old man who complains about everything.
senses.exPt: Meu vizinho é um velho briguento que reclama de tudo.

senses.def: a place where stone is dug out of the ground
senses.ex: The stone for the church came from a local quarry.
senses.exPt: A pedra da igreja veio de uma pedreira da região.

senses.def: an animal or person being hunted or chased
senses.ex: The hunters followed their quarry into the woods.
senses.exPt: Os caçadores seguiram a presa até a mata.

senses.def: one of four equal parts of something
senses.ex: A quarter of the students live near the school.
senses.exPt: Um quarto dos alunos mora perto da escola.

senses.def: fifteen minutes before or after the hour
senses.ex: The class starts at a quarter past ten.
senses.exPt: A aula começa às dez e quinze.

senses.def: a woman who rules a country, or the wife of a king
senses.ex: The queen lives in a big palace.
senses.exPt: A rainha mora em um grande palácio.

senses.def: gay, lesbian or not following traditional ideas about gender and sexuality
senses.ex: The festival celebrates queer artists from around the world.
senses.exPt: O festival celebra artistas queer do mundo todo.

senses.def: strange or unusual (old-fashioned)
senses.ex: I had a queer feeling that someone was watching me.
senses.exPt: Tive uma sensação estranha de que alguém estava me observando.

senses.def: a question, especially one asked to get information
senses.ex: If you have any queries, please contact our customer service team.
senses.exPt: Se tiver alguma dúvida, entre em contato com nossa equipe de atendimento.

senses.def: a long search for something difficult to find
senses.ex: Their quest for a cure has lasted over twenty years.
senses.exPt: A busca deles por uma cura já dura mais de vinte anos.

senses.def: something you ask to get information
senses.ex: Can I ask you a question?
senses.exPt: Posso te fazer uma pergunta?

senses.def: a subject or problem that people discuss
senses.ex: It's only a question of time.
senses.exPt: É só uma questão de tempo.

senses.def: the mark ? written at the end of a question
senses.ex: Don't forget to put a question mark at the end.
senses.exPt: Não esqueça de colocar um ponto de interrogação no final.

senses.def: a list of written questions to get information from people
senses.ex: Please fill in this short questionnaire about our service.
senses.exPt: Por favor, preencha este breve questionário sobre o nosso atendimento.

senses.def: a line of people waiting for something
senses.ex: There was a long queue outside the cinema.
senses.exPt: Havia uma fila enorme na frente do cinema.

senses.def: done or happening in a short time
senses.ex: Can I ask you a quick question?
senses.exPt: Posso te fazer uma pergunta rápida?

senses.def: fast, or in a short time
senses.ex: She quickly finished her homework and went out.
senses.exPt: Ela terminou a lição rápido e saiu.

senses.def: making very little noise
senses.ex: The library is always very quiet.
senses.exPt: A biblioteca é sempre muito silenciosa.

senses.def: not talking much
senses.ex: You're very quiet today. Are you OK?
senses.exPt: Você está muito quieto hoje. Está tudo bem?

senses.def: calm, without many people or much activity
senses.ex: We live on a quiet street near the park.
senses.exPt: Moramos numa rua tranquila perto do parque.

senses.def: speaking with a soft voice
senses.ex: Please speak quietly in the library.
senses.exPt: Por favor, fale baixo na biblioteca.

senses.def: making very little noise
senses.ex: He quietly left the room.
senses.exPt: Ele saiu do quarto sem fazer barulho.

senses.def: a short, clever and funny remark
senses.ex: He made a quick quip about the weather and everyone laughed.
senses.exPt: Ele fez uma piada rápida sobre o tempo e todo mundo riu.

senses.def: to say something short, clever and funny
senses.ex: 'At least it isn't raining,' she quipped as we got off the bus.
senses.exPt: “Pelo menos não está chovendo”, ela brincou quando descemos do ônibus.

senses.def: a strange habit or feature of someone's character
senses.ex: Everyone has their own little quirks and habits.
senses.exPt: Todo mundo tem suas pequenas manias e costumes.

senses.def: a strange thing that happens by chance
senses.ex: By a quirk of fate, we ended up on the same train.
senses.exPt: Por um capricho do destino, acabamos no mesmo trem.

senses.def: unusual in an interesting or attractive way
senses.ex: She has a quirky sense of humour that I really love.
senses.exPt: Ela tem um senso de humor peculiar que eu adoro.

senses.def: to leave your job or school
senses.ex: She quit her job last month.
senses.exPt: Ela largou o emprego mês passado.

senses.def: to stop doing something, especially a bad habit
senses.ex: My dad quit smoking ten years ago.
senses.exPt: Meu pai parou de fumar há dez anos.

senses.def: more than a little, but not very
senses.ex: It's quite cold today, so wear a jacket.
senses.exPt: Está bastante frio hoje, então vista uma jaqueta.

senses.def: completely, often used with not
senses.ex: I'm not quite ready yet.
senses.exPt: Ainda não estou totalmente pronto.

senses.def: a game where people answer questions to test their knowledge
senses.ex: Let's do a quiz about animals!
senses.exPt: Vamos fazer um quiz sobre animais!

senses.def: a short test at school
senses.ex: We have a short maths quiz tomorrow.
senses.exPt: Temos um teste rápido de matemática amanhã.

senses.def: interesting or clever enough to be repeated by others
senses.ex: Her speech was full of quotable lines.
senses.exPt: O discurso dela estava cheio de frases dignas de citação.

senses.def: words from a book or speech repeated by someone else
senses.ex: The essay starts with a quotation from a famous poem.
senses.exPt: A redação começa com uma citação de um poema famoso.

senses.def: a statement of how much a piece of work will cost
senses.ex: We got three quotations for the new roof.
senses.exPt: Recebemos três orçamentos para o telhado novo.

senses.def: to repeat the exact words that someone else said or wrote
senses.ex: He often quotes famous writers in his speeches.
senses.exPt: Ele costuma citar escritores famosos nos seus discursos.

senses.def: words from a book, film or speech repeated by someone else
senses.ex: She put a famous quote about love on her wall.
senses.exPt: Ela colocou uma frase famosa sobre o amor na parede.

senses.def: the price someone says they will charge for a piece of work
senses.ex: We got three quotes before choosing a builder.
senses.exPt: Fizemos três orçamentos antes de escolher um pedreiro.
